targetText: And the capitalist has absolutely gained £20, because he actually paid for the labour-power 20 per cent less than its value, or cut nominal wages 20 per cent by a circuitous route.
explanation: The circuit of capital describes how value transforms from money capital into productive assets (machinery/labor) and commodity capital, returning as expanded money capital.

targetText: The study of the exchange of newly produced gold within the constant capital of department I is not contained in the manuscript.
explanation: Department I represents the branch of production that manufactures means of production (machinery, raw materials, industrial equipment).
